messages:
elena_cs: Quick async check-in for Rancho Health (renewal in 10d). We saw intermittent 503s on embeddings webhook last night during a traffic spike. Filed a ticket and started triage.
elena_cs: What I did: collected request_ids + sample payloads, asked CS to enable verbose SDK logs, opened ticket CS-8237, looped in Eng + SRE.

tom_eng: I pulled host metricsnoticed one model-pool host hitting repeated 502/oom-kill patterns. Created diagnostic PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/5261

tom_eng: Quick repro (local):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 
  -d '{"input":["health claim 123"]}'
```

marta_se: Ran a sim with prefix caching enabled for their workload. Requests dropped ~18% and CPU spikes smoothed. Could we flip an org-scoped config as a band-aid?

ravi_sre: I can start a temporary scaled pool in us-west (2x) for 6h to give us breathing room. Will watch autoscaler and open an incident channel if it flaps.

elena_cs: Please do that @ravi_sre, good call. I'll notify Rancho that we're applying a temporary mitigation and ask them to enable client retries/backoff.

marta_se: I can draft an org-scoped config change. Prefer to gate it behind the PR canary so we don't mass-affect other customers.

ravi_sre: Temp pool spun up now. Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.ai/d/Rancho/embeddings-queue (monitoring link). Alerting set for error-rate >1%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started deployment of serving/5261 to staging (build 2025.02.13). CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/22901


tom_eng: Staging canary 30m: error rate 2.7% -> 0.5%, p95 latency from 410ms -> 250ms. No OOMs observed on canary hosts.

elena_cs: Great. Action list:
- @tom_eng: promote PR to prod if canary stays green + add short-term IP-based fallback route for Rancho
- @marta_se: prepare org-scoped config and a rollback plan
- @ravi_sre: keep temp pool live until we confirm stability (aiming 4-6h)
- @elena_cs: update customer with ETA and mitigation steps (client retries/backoff)

marta_se: Approved. Ill push the org config immediately after prod deploy and tag the change CS-8237-hotfix.

ravi_sre: Monitoring looks steady. Will keep a 15m cadence check for next 3h and post updates here.

elena_cs: Sending Rancho a short playbook now: enable SDK retries (3 attempts, exponential backoff 200ms->1s), temporary routing, and expected rollback. Will paste copy here once sent.

elena_cs: [SENT TO RANCHO] "Weve applied a temporary capacity and configuration mitigation to reduce 503s. We recommend enabling SDK retries (3) and backoff; we'll follow up with a permanent fix within 24h. Contact me directly if you see anything after we promote to prod. -Elena"

tom_eng: I'll schedule a short postmortem: root cause looks like pool autoscale thresholds + kernel OOM interactions. Follow-ups: adjust cgroup limits, tune autoscaler window, and add a health-check that drains before kill.

elena_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll post a renewal-status update to the account thread and flag this as "high-priority renewal" until customer acknowledges. If anything changes, ping @elena_cs; otherwise I'll report back in ~2-3h with customer ack.

marta_se: :thumbsup:

tom_eng: :thumbsup:

ravi_sre: :thumbsup:
